descriptor.name: Agriculture Information Services
descriptor.shortDesc: Knowledge retrieval and mandi-price capabilities for agricultural applications.
descriptor.longDesc: This catalog advertises two independent capabilities from one Provider. Consumers may discover either capability and invoke it through the applicable Beckn interaction.

descriptor.name: Agriculture Information Services
descriptor.shortDesc: Provider of governed agricultural knowledge and live mandi-price information.
descriptor.longDesc: The Provider maintains reviewed knowledge sources and connects to authoritative agricultural market information systems.

descriptor.name: Agricultural knowledge retrieval
descriptor.shortDesc: Retrieves reviewed agricultural knowledge in supported languages.
descriptor.longDesc: Use this capability to retrieve general or subject-specific agricultural knowledge. A returned knowledge item uses the OpenAgriNet KnowledgeResource contract.

descriptor.name: Live mandi-price observation
descriptor.shortDesc: Returns current commodity prices for supported agricultural markets.
descriptor.longDesc: Use this capability with a commodity, market, and applicable date. A successful result uses the OpenAgriNet MandiPriceObservation contract.
